title: 第17章 女孩子随便养养就行了
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
赵玉兰呱唧呱唧的时候，苗苗已经吃上第二块肉了，腮帮子鼓鼓地嚼着，边听大人说话。

    其实压根也没听懂，反正只要没点名道姓，小破孩就自动认为和自己没关系。

    蔡老太重新捡起筷子，把芽芽吃到鼻尖上的饭粒给拿下来，说：“你要是觉得自己不配吃肉就不要吃，我不管你，你也别管别人怎么吃。”

    魏建业忙做和事佬，给赵玉兰夹了一块红烧肉，“你吃，吃完了我再买。”

    赵玉兰心里头也委屈，明明一点好处都没捞着，怎么就成了她的错了？

    而且婆婆不乐意，那谁还做这鸡婆的事啊。

    有红烧肉谁不乐意吃谁就是傻子。

    眼前的红烧肉好像是一块大瘦肉呢，虽然比不上肥肉吃着油润，但是肉就是好东西。

    赵玉兰万分珍惜的咬了一口，嚼巴两下才察觉出来是姜，心里的泪水哗啦啦的流。

    她咋摊上一个手气那么背的男人呢！

    这会饭桌上好不容易又重新和谐起来，赵玉兰怕惹婆婆说她又作妖，愣是就着饭吃了一大块生姜。

    魏建业此时也想叫气氛活跃些，嗅了嗅空气说：“湿度太大了，台风也就是明后两天的事。”

    他还真得和没经历过台风的家里人认真说道说道，“台风不像是咱们老家刮风下雨就完事了，风级大的时候能把屋顶和树掀翻，咱们离海边近，所以到时候受灾可能更严重点。

    你们没来的时候周围的树为了防台风已经砍得差不多了，屋顶也都是加固过的，等下食堂该发物资了，咱们领回来台风天的时候可不能出门。”

    魏建业后怕叹气，“咱们赶巧正好在台风天来临的时候登岛，否则之后台风天停航，留你们单独在外头等复航，我得担心死。”

    他也不是没想过让家里人晚点过来。

    可车票能买着就是幸运，哪还能让人挑什么时候走。

    再说还得转车，也都没法预测时间。

    所以还得是老天爷保佑，一家子到底是团聚上了。

    一家人聚精会神地听，连带赵玉兰都说：“这台风还能把屋顶给掀翻咯？你平日里写信回家也不说说，就自个待在那么吓人的地方。”

    魏建业心里也苦啊，“这可不能说，气象信息得保密。”

    他神秘兮兮地让家里人想想，要是坏蛋份子利用气象就完犊子了。
content_en:
When Zhao Yulan was croaking, Miaomiao had already eaten the second piece of meat, chewing with bulging cheeks while listening to the adults talking.

In fact, I didn't understand it at all. Anyway, as long as the name was not mentioned, the little boy automatically thought it had nothing to do with him.

Mrs. Cai picked up the chopsticks again, took off the rice grains that Ya Ya had eaten on the tip of her nose, and said, "If you feel you are not worthy of eating meat, don't eat it. I don't care about you, and you don't care how others eat it."

Wei Jianye was busy being the peacemaker and gave Zhao Yulan a piece of braised pork, "You eat it, and I'll buy it when you're done."

Zhao Yulan felt aggrieved. She obviously didn't get any benefits at all, so why was it her fault?

And if the mother-in-law is not happy, then who would do such a thing for a mother-in-law?

Anyone who doesn't enjoy eating braised pork is a fool.

The braised pork in front of me seems to be a big piece of lean meat. Although it is not as oily as fat meat, the meat is good.

Zhao Yulan took a bite with great treasure. After chewing twice, she realized that it was ginger, and tears flowed in her heart.

How could she fall in love with a man who was so unlucky!

At this time, the dinner table finally became harmonious again. Zhao Yulan was afraid of offending her mother-in-law and saying that she was acting like a monster again, so she ate a large piece of ginger with the meal.

Wei Jianye also wanted to liven up the atmosphere at this time. He sniffed the air and said, "The humidity is too high. The typhoon will only happen tomorrow or two days later."

He really had to have a serious talk with his family members who had never experienced a typhoon, "A typhoon is not like wind and rain in our hometown. When the wind is strong, it can overturn roofs and trees. We are close to the sea, so the damage may be more serious."

When you didn't come, the surrounding trees had been cut down to prevent typhoons, and the roofs had been reinforced. It's time for the canteen to distribute supplies later, and we can't go out during the typhoon."

Wei Jianye later sighed, "We happened to land on the island just when the typhoon is coming. Otherwise, if the sailings are suspended during the typhoon, leaving you alone outside to wait for the resumption of sailings, I would be worried to death."

It's not like he didn't think about asking his family to come over later.

But if you can buy a ticket, you are lucky. How can you choose when to leave?

Besides, we have to change trains, and we can’t predict the time.

So God bless us, and the family is finally reunited.

The whole family listened attentively, and even Zhao Yulan said: "Can this typhoon knock off the roof? You usually don't say anything when you write home, and you just stay in such a scary place by yourself."

Wei Jianye felt miserable, "This can't be said. Weather information must be kept confidential."

He mysteriously asked his family to think about it, if the bad guys took advantage of the weather, it would be the end of the world.
title_en: Chapter 17 Just raise the girl as you like
